Major SPS Oberoi on Instagram: "Is Benjamin Netanyahu Dead? Viral Video Fact Check | AI Fake or Real Truth?

In this video, we carefully analyze the truth behind the viral claim. As of now, the Israeli government has not released any official statement confirming the death of Benjamin Netanyahu. Many experts are also suggesting that the circulating clip could be an AI-generated or manipulated video. One of the key observations people noticed is that the person in the viral clip appears to have six fingers, which has raised doubts about the authenticity of the footage.

We also discuss other possibilities. In international relations and security situations, countries sometimes use look-alike or duplicate individuals to protect high-profile leaders when there is a threat to their lives. Another possibility is that the rumor could be propaganda from geopolitical rivals, potentially linked to tensions involving Iran and Israel.
